category_title: Highly anxious students with bipolar disorder who thrive in low-pressure environments
scenario_title: Fear of ridicule and mistakes during a cookery task
minimal_context: Shirley is attempting to cook a meal from scratch during a cookery course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to cook a meal from scratch. Please go to your station and begin preparing your ingredients.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have never cooked a meal from scratch before. I am feeling extremely nervous about doing this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at the recipe and try to get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm fearful of the other students. Even though we are with our own people who have mental problems and aren't normal people, I'm still terrified of being laughed at if I do something wrong.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Don't worry about the others, just focus on your own cooking and try to get the steps right.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it. I remember my school days with alarming clarity, and I am so afraid that you are going to ridicule my wrong answers if I make a mistake. I don't know what to do next, but I feel too much embarrassment about asking for help.

task.learning_goal: Gradually came to see mistakes as being part of the learning process

context.materials: Ingredients to cook a meal from scratch
context.social_setting: With 'their own people' (i.e. people who also had mental health difficulties)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When anticipating or making a mistake, fearing that the teacher might ridicule their 'wrong' answers
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Extremely nervous, embarrassment about asking for help
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Fearful of the other students, fearing being laughed at, fear of failure based on previous negative educational experiences
related_quotes: You amazed me when you said it did not matter if we made mistakes as you made them too, even though you were an experienced cook! That was a shock to me, but a big help as I relaxed then.

behavior_patterns.condition: When returning to education and facing tasks that might result in mistakes
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Remembered negative educational experiences from school days with alarming clarity, causing much fear
